# LuFe/Mn/O Source-Triage Fixture

This directory contains synthetic, sanitized paper/figure/panel corpus fixtures for the LuFe/Mn/O BT-7 known-answer regression. It intentionally contains no raw BT-7 data and no generated real-data artifacts.

The TAS data-file side of the regression uses `eval/figure_source_lu_femn_o3_triage.yaml`, which is also synthetic.
